recent_posts.title:
GPT-5.5 Instant is starting to roll out in ChatGPT.

It’s a big upgrade, giving you smarter, clearer, and more personalized answers in a warmer, more natural tone.

And it's also more concise, which we heard you wanted. We think you'll love chatting with it.
recent_posts.summary: OpenAI is rolling out GPT-5.5 Instant as the default model for all ChatGPT users over the next two days. Key improvements include smarter, more factual, and more concise responses with a warmer tone, stronger performance on image analysis, STEM questions, and web search tasks. The update also brings enhanced memory and personalization features, allowing ChatGPT to draw on saved memories, past chats, files, and connected Gmail accounts. Memory sources are available across all consumer plans, while personalization improvements are initially for Plus and Pro users on the web. The model is also available via API as 'gpt-5.5-chat-latest'.
